赵志军的眼睛亮了一下，又迅速暗了下去：“我……我不会做饭啊。”

“没人天生会，我也不会，是学的。”

赵志军沉默了。

他低头看着手里的烟，烟灰掉了一地，他也不弹。

他的脑子里在打架。

一方面，他觉得一个月三十块太少了，配不上他赵志军的身份。

另一方面，他又确实想要那台收音机，而且……三姐夫说的“以后自己开店”，听起来好像挺诱人的。

“国强，”王桂兰小心翼翼地说，“志军他……他啥也不会，去你店里别给你添麻烦……”

“妈，没事。”林国强笑了笑，“谁都是从不会到会的。

志军聪明，学东西快，只要他肯干，我保证把他教会。”

这话说得赵志军心里舒坦了不少。

“志军聪明”这四个字，正好搔到了他的痒处。

“那……那我试试？”

赵志军的声音小了很多，那种理直气壮的气焰已经消了大半。

“行，下周一过来，我教你。”

林国强站起来，拍了拍他的肩膀，“志军，我跟你说句实话。

你三姐夫我以前也是个混日子的，觉得能活着就行。

后来我想明白了，人活着，不能总伸手跟别人要。

你得自己能挣，挣来的东西，用着才踏实。”

赵志军低着头，没说话，但他的手在发抖。

不是气的，是某种他不愿意承认的东西……羞耻。

他二十岁了，从来没有挣过一分钱。

从小到大，想要什么就跟家里要，家里不给就闹，闹了就给。

他以为这是天经地义的。

但今天，三姐夫没有给他钱，而是给了他一个机会。

一个自己挣钱的机会。

他忽然觉得，手里这根大前门，抽着没那么香了。

赵德厚坐在太师椅上，看着这一幕，眼眶微微泛红。

他看了林国强一眼，那眼神里有感激，有欣慰。

还有一种“这个女婿终于立起来了”的感慨。

王桂兰转过身去，假装去灶房端菜，偷偷抹了一把眼泪。

孙建民和刘胜利对视了一眼，什么都没说。

但他们的眼神变了。

Zhao Zhijun's eyes lit up for a moment, then dimmed quickly: "I...I don't know how to cook."

"No one is born with it, and I don't know it either. I learn it."

Zhao Zhijun was silent.

He looked down at the cigarette in his hand. The ashes fell to the floor, but he didn't flick it.

There was a fight in his head.

On the one hand, he felt that thirty yuan a month was too little and not worthy of his status as Zhao Zhijun.

On the other hand, he really wanted that radio, and... what the third brother-in-law said about "opening his own shop in the future" sounded quite tempting.

"Guoqiang," Wang Guilan said cautiously, "Zhijun...he doesn't know anything. Don't cause any trouble to you when he goes to your store..."

"Mom, it's okay." Lin Guoqiang smiled, "No one ever comes to meetings.

Zhijun is smart and a quick learner. As long as he is willing to work, I promise to teach him."

These words made Zhao Zhijun feel a lot more comfortable.

The words "Zhijun is smart" just scratched his itch.

"Then...then let me try?"

Zhao Zhijun's voice was much softer, and most of his confident arrogance had disappeared.

"Okay, come here next Monday and I'll teach you."

Lin Guoqiang stood up and patted his shoulder, "Zhijun, let me tell you the truth.

Your third brother-in-law, I used to be a dawdler, so I thought it would be fine as long as I could survive.

Later, I figured it out. When you are alive, you cannot always reach out and ask for others.

You have to be able to earn it yourself, and only when you use what you earn can you be practical."

Zhao Zhijun lowered his head and said nothing, but his hands were shaking.

It's not anger, it's something he doesn't want to admit... shame.

He was twenty years old and had never earned a penny.

Growing up, I asked my family for whatever I wanted. If the family didn't give it to me, I would make a fuss. If the family made a fuss, I would give it to me.

He thought this was natural.

But today, the third brother-in-law did not give him money, but gave him a chance.

An opportunity to make your own money.

He suddenly felt that the big front door in his hand was no longer so fragrant when smoked.

Zhao Dehou was sitting on the Taishi chair, watching this scene, his eyes were slightly red.

He glanced at Lin Guoqiang, with gratitude and relief in his eyes.

There is also a feeling of "this son-in-law has finally stood up".

Wang Guilan turned around, pretended to go to the kitchen to serve food, and secretly wiped away her tears.

Sun Jianmin and Liu Shengli looked at each other and said nothing.

But their eyes changed.
